title: Star Wars RPG — Frontier Mystery Story & Actual-Play Listening Mix
privacy: General sci-fi inspiration only. No private adventure names, world details, original characters, session events or private source links.
policy: First 10 alternating five licensed publisher-hosted standalone podcast-drama pilots and five Star Wars tabletop actual-play arc pilots (no lore interruptions); next five ordinary lore + story pairs from the preexisting ranked collection, preserving their story sequence. No paid audiobook enclosures or generated recordings.

dramas.title: Among the Stars and Bones
dramas.motive: Alien archaeology: field reports, exploration teams, unfamiliar ruins and protective ancient structures.

dramas.title: Station 151
dramas.motive: Isolated research team, corporate secrecy and the social effect of dangerous infrastructure.

dramas.title: The White Vault
dramas.motive: Multilingual repair expedition, hostile exterior, outpost routines and the discovery of buried secrets.

dramas.title: VAST Horizon
dramas.motive: Abandoned colonization vessel, malfunctioning AI, environmental controls and emergency survival.

dramas.title: The Hyacinth Disaster
dramas.motive: Working-class asteroid crew, failing equipment, rescue pressure and believable decisions under stress.

Prison-planet atmosphere, organizational control and lived-in frontier scenes

Cinematic FFG improvisation, new settlements and equipment
Crew banter, negotiations, improvisational contacts and local culture

notes: Non-Star-Wars science fiction and horror are labeled CROSS-GENRE INSPIRATION; Star Wars continuity is not implied.
